model.maintenance: non-negative OLS: fixed + simulator maintenance cycles
model.reader: non-negative OLS: simulator reader active cycles + issued memory requests + level-cache 64-bit words
model.compute: non-negative OLS: simulator compute active cycles + active-bitmap scan words + processed edges
model.iterative_span: max(predicted reader, predicted compute) + non-negative per-round residual

admission.correctness: simulator success and both architecture and mathematical mismatch counters are zero
admission.memory_fifo_owner_ledgers: all available request, byte, FIFO, owner, dispatch, and work-credit ledgers must close

model_selection_note: The v4 total-span form failed on LJ/LJ08. Source inspection identified two omitted routed mechanisms: the reader's fixed family-by-level metadata walk and compute active-bitmap sweeps. All eight inspected batch-8 rows are therefore calibration/development evidence in v5.
freeze_note: This contract and the exact AU/SU batch-64 workload hashes were frozen before either holdout workload was executed in the v5 simulator or on the FPGA.
